mapper.update: INSERT INTO patent (merge_key, patent_type, registration_number, application_date, title, url) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{patentType}, #{registrationNumber}, #{applicationDate}::date, #{title}, #{url}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO company_patent (company_id, patent_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id) SELECT c.company_id, p.patent_id, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid FROM company c JOIN patent p ON p.merge_key = #{dto.mergeKey} WHERE c.corporate_number = #{dto.corporateNumber} ON CONFLICT (company_id, patent_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id WHERE company_patent.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM false OR company_patent.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.sync_id
UPDATE company_patent cp SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE cp.deleted = false AND cp.company_id = ( SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} )

UPDATE company_patent cp SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE cp.deleted = false AND cp.company_id = ( SELECT c.company_id FROM company c WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} ) AND cp.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{syncId}::uuid
